# Clearpine Technologies

> Clearpine Technologies Inc. is a managed IT service provider (MSP) headquartered in Abbotsford, British Columbia, Canada. It provides managed IT support, co-managed IT, cybersecurity, hardware deployment and IT project management for small and mid-sized businesses, healthcare clinics, law firms and public sector organizations across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver (Lower Mainland), with remote support across Canada.

## Key facts

- Legal name: Clearpine Technologies Inc. (federally incorporated under the CBCA; registered extraprovincially in BC). Founded 2026.
- Head office: Abbotsford, BC, Canada.
- Phone: (236) 258-3060. Email: info@clearpinetech.ca. Website: https://clearpinetech.ca/
- On-site service area: Abbotsford, Chilliwack, Mission, Langley, Maple Ridge, Surrey, New Westminster, Burnaby, Vancouver, North Vancouver and Whistler. Remote support Canada-wide.
- Managed IT support price: $95 CAD per user per month, minimum 5 users, 1-year agreement, delivered remotely during business hours. Custom billing for fewer than 5 users. Microsoft 365 licences, after-hours support and on-site visits are billed separately; on-site visits are free if the problem cannot be fixed remotely.
- Free, no-obligation IT assessment: on site anywhere within 300 km of Abbotsford for a business of any size, or remotely.
- Home tech support (separate service for households): remote help for households in Canada and the USA, flat $100 CAD per session.
